name: Sequence-of-events recorder
summary: Recorder that timestamps changes of state on many binary inputs so the order of operations can be reconstructed.
description: A sequence-of-events recorder monitors breaker auxiliary contacts, protection trip outputs, alarms and other binary signals, and stores each change with an accurate timestamp. After an incident the list shows which device operated first, which is often impossible to tell from alarms alone.

Timestamp resolution and time synchronisation are what make the record useful. The symbol does not show the time source, such as a GPS clock, or the debounce settings on each input, and without synchronisation records from different devices cannot be merged reliably.
readingNotes: Check which contacts are wired as inputs.
distinction: An SOE recorder logs binary changes in time order; a disturbance recorder captures analogue waveforms.
